opening.argument: The speaker ties commissions directly to bringing people into a program, explaining that referring someone can bring a commission or reward and that maximizing commissions means introducing large numbers of people through marketing funnels. She presents the team marketing the current program as central to success, claims this opportunity can provide “massive income,” and invites viewers to join her team through a link. Together, those statements show a current opportunity promoted through recruitment and team-based marketing, with commissions and substantial income held out as the draw. Her remarks about possible one-percent daily returns and affiliate commissions concern earlier programs and are qualified or retrospective; they do not establish the current opportunity’s terms.
